subject: nimbleOptions and nimbleInternalFunctions not found for package built on nimble

messages.author: 46f76d1903dc6874
messages.subject: nimbleOptions and nimbleInternalFunctions not found for package built on nimble
parts:
When running an MCMC sampler using nimble in a poackage I'm working on, I get these errors:

Error in nimbleOptions("experimentalEnableDerivs") : 
  could not find function "nimbleOptions"

and sometimes this

Error: object 'nimbleInternalFunctions' not found

I've tried importing nimble in its entirety in my NAMESPACE, and I've also tried adding importFrom(nimble, nimbleOptions) and importFrom(nimble, nimbleInternalFunctions). Nothing has worked so far. If I run library(nimble) before loading my package, everything works, but requiring users to run library(nimble) before using any of the functions in my package is not ideal. Any ideas on what might be going on?

Thanks for any assistance!
Vincent

Hi Chris,

Thanks for checking it out. You can clone this repo: https://gitlab.com/actionable-phenology/tvgeomMCMC

And for repeatability's sake, you can use this docker image too https://hub.docker.com/r/vlandau/r-nimble and volume mount the repo.

This is the code I use to run the container:

docker run -it --rm \
    -v "$(pwd)":/home/tvgeomMCMC \
    -e USER=tvgeomMCMC \
    -e PASSWORD=tvgeomMCMC \
    -p 8664:8787 \
    vlandau/r-nimble:3.6.1

Then open up http://localhost:8664 in a browser and enter tvgeomMCMC for user and password when prompted (this may all be info you already know but just wanted to be thorough).

You should be able to replicate the issue by running the following code in a fresh R session:

devtools::install()
library(tvgeomMCMC)
data <- simulate_tvgeom(n = 100, 
                        t = 50, 
                        covariates = NA,
                        intercept = -4, 
                        beta = c(0.1, 0.8, -2.2),
                        censored = TRUE)

draws <- tvgeom_mcmc(y = data$y,
                     covariates = data$covariates,
                     beta_start = c(-5, 0, 0, 0),
                     n_iter = 100,
                     n_burnin = 10)

messages.author: 5fa2a363d4ddd1d1
messages.subject: Re: nimbleOptions and nimbleInternalFunctions not found for package built on nimble
parts:
hi Vincent,

The brief answer here is to put 'nimble' into 'Depends', not 'Imports'
in DESCRIPTION.

When your code calls nimbleModel(), we are creating a bunch of
functions for each node in the model that allow calculation of the
density of that node, simulation from that node, etc. These functions
are created in a reference class for the model that we dynamically
generate. What that means is that the reference class is not part of
the nimble namespace (because it was created in the context of your
package) but those functions that we generate do use functions from
the nimble namespace. So nimble itself needs to be loaded in order
for the functions from the nimble namespace to be found.

I'll bring this up with our development team for us to think a bit
more about whether it would make sense to rearrange things so nimble
can be in 'Imports'.

chris
